_comment: Event vocabulary for worktree-event. Each event declares flag operations and JSON patches. Unknown events are rejected. See docs/worktree-context-system.md.
_jq_bindings: json_patches receive these bound vars: $now (ISO8601), $exit_code (int, or null), $error (str, or null), $pr_state (str, or null), $text (str, or null).

worktree-created.description: Called after a new worktree dir is set up. Creates session dir if absent. --ticket required.

worktree-abandoned.description: Worktree is being deleted. Clears all flags. --ticket required.

commit-made.description: A commit landed. Queues a summary refresh.

claude-turn-ended.description: Claude finished a response (Stop hook). Queues summary refresh.

claude-session-paused.description: User explicitly paused via /pause-worktree. Forces a refresh even if signal hash unchanged.

conductor-queued.description: Ticket was labelled for conductor. --ticket required.

conductor-finished.description: Conductor run completed successfully. --ticket and --exit-code required. Queues summary refresh.

note-added.description: User added a manual note via /pause-worktree or similar. --text required.

summary-written.description: Summarizer finished writing context.md + summary.json. Clears the dirty flags.

conductor-state-reported.description: Reports a rich state (awaiting_ci, merged, needs_input, etc.) into conductor.json so the picker sees it and queues a summary refresh. --ticket and --text (state|detail) required.
